name: Haus
short_desc: Meters, shared costs, tasks and wiki for a building shared by a few households.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Server for the Haus apps (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows) and the web app it serves at its own address: meter readings, the Betriebskosten split and yearly statement, tasks, appointments, equipment and a wiki. Open the app's domain in a browser, or enter it in one of the apps.
